_comment: Permission-gate rule switches. Set a rule to false to disable it. Rule IDs (R1, P3, ...) are the internal cross-reference used in source comments and the README rule table; the keys here are the stable, human-readable names. Env overrides: PGATE_<KEY>=0 disables one rule for a single run without editing this file. Inert rules stay inert regardless of the value (see each rule's README row).
